Name: Belphegor
Basic Side:
When one of your fire units wins combat: 
Gain a victory counter on this Emblem. Only two per Cycle.
Condition:
Four Rauhnacht-Feuergeister units contributed to four victory counters: 
Inactivate this Emblem and Empower the Star Player Belphegor
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Flauros
Basic Side:
When a fire unit alters the Attack or Defense of another fire unit: 
Give the unit with the changed stat +1 Attack during combat.
Condition:
Four Rauhnacht-Feuergeister units have fused with each other: 
Inactivate this Emblem and Empower the Star Player Flauros
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.
